summary: Allows users to download student data from the system into an Excel file for external use or reporting.
steps: Navigate to either 'Student List' or 'Student List Course Wise'.
Click on the 'Export to Excel' button (usually found on the page).
The student data will be downloaded as an Excel file to your device.
important_notes: This option is available from both the general 'Student List' and the 'Student List Course Wise' views.
questions: How do I export student data to an Excel file?
